rulings.restated: Divide helper "The business use percentage, as cents" by helper "One hundred cents (100%)", rounded to 6 decimal places; if the result is 1 or more, use 1 (and 0 if it is less than 0). Multiply helper "Cost or other basis" by the result.
rulings.model: The program stops after multiplying cost by business-use percentage. The IRS says: "multiply the cost or other basis of the property by the percentage of business/investment use. From that result, subtract any credits and deductions allocable to the property," including "Section 179 expense deduction" and "Any special depreciation allowance included on line 14."
rulings.ruling: Ruling: deferred to T-030 (owner); values unaffected.
